author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The standalone Quick Search trigger uses an anchor as a button.
findings.consequence: The control is keyboard-operable today through manual Enter and Space handlers, but it duplicates native button semantics and can drift from expected button behavior for future disabled, form, or interaction states.
findings.evidence: The owned template starts at line 387 and renders the `Snabbsökning` trigger as an `<a>` with `role="button"` and `tabindex="0"`; the control does not navigate anywhere and only opens the modal.
findings.recommendation: Render the trigger as `<button type="button" class="quick-search-trigger">Snabbsökning</button>`, keep the click handler, title, and ref, and remove the manual Enter/Space handlers unless a test shows custom behavior is still needed.
